headline: Ownership Shifts Mark Restless Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest ownership change is in Linn’s Mercy: Colonial control has risen from eight strategic bases to ten, while Warden holdings have fallen from two to none; one remains neutral. Nevish Line has likewise shifted by count, from one Warden, five Colonial and two neutral bases to three Warden and five Colonial, with the neutral pair gone. Both fronts remain busy: Nevish logged ten event rows in two hours, Linn four. Callahan’s Passage, previously all Warden-held, now has nine Warden bases and one neutral; two event rows mark renewed recent turnover, alongside sharply accelerating casualty and enlistment rates on both sides. Weathered Expanse holds at seven Warden and two neutral bases, but its event stream has fallen quiet in the last two hours after nine rows in six. Mooring County remains 11 Warden to one Colonial, and Marban Hollow four to three with one neutral; both have had no events in six hours. The war remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
